units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 82b:13">B. Kam. 82ᵇ</cite> (v. <cite ref="O00843">preced.</cite>) <he>משום ס׳</he> on account of the bad odor of decaying matter in gardens.
Pes. 35ᵃ שאין באין לידי חימוץ אלא לידי ס׳ which do not ferment (v. חִימּוּץ) but decay; Y. Ḥall. I, beg. 57ᵃ.—Trnsf. offense, mischief, fault.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73">Gen. R. s. 73</cite>, <he>הס׳ ניתלה בה</he> whatever mischief is done in the house is put upon her.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:15">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>ואין הס׳ נתלה אלא בי</he> none will be blamed but myself.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:19">Num. R. s. 20</cite>, end <he>ע״י ס׳ הם נמנים</he> they were counted whenever they had sinned (and had been punished with pestilence).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 44:1">Pesik. R. s. 44</cite> <he>מי שאין לו חטא ולא ס׳</he> he who is without sin or fault; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="O00421"><he>סוֹרְחָן</he></cite>.
